correctness.rationale: The full powered-distance block matrix follows from explicit affine shortest-path distances. The incidence identity BB^T=qI+J yields an exhaustive orthogonal quadratic decomposition. At p*=log2(q/(q-1)) the q-dimensional class contrast sector vanishes; for q>=3 the mixed determinant is >=a(a-2)^2>0 and the uniform sector is <q(a-2)<0. For q=2 the metric is exactly the Hamming distance of weight-one and weight-two subsets of a four-element set, hence the squared Euclidean metric of four binary coordinates. Two-class contrast gives positive quadratic value at every p>p*. Li–Weston gives strictness below p*. The centered Gram rank counts give all equality directions and minimal Hilbert dimensions. Independent finite-field graph and Jacobi checks were executed for q=2,3,4,5,7; they are corroboration, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: This is a motivated sharp metric-embedding invariant of every existing finite affine plane. It proves that the complete-multipartite parallel-line obstruction remains exact even after all points are added, determines the entire critical equality kernel, and exhibits an exceptional q=2 rank resonance. The q-dimensional versus five-dimensional endpoint rank collapse is structural geometry, not a renamed graph/table entry. The proof is uniform over non-Desarguesian planes and addresses a natural infinite family, rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
